guidetextdraw._value: Instructions: The Social Security Administration was unable to confirm some of the information you provided on your 2022-2023 Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA). In order to be considered for Federal Student Aid, you must provide our office with additional documentation. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
